    ExtriangulatedRealization.isInjectiveObject_of_ext_eq_zero

    Injective objects of an extriangulated category #

    An object U with E(-, U) = 0 is injective: for a conflation A → B → C realizing δ and f : A ⟶ U, the extension f_* δ vanishes, so condition (∗) applied to the split conflation U → U ⊞ C → C gives a morphism B ⟶ U ⊞ C extending f.
